high_level_description: This image depicts a cozy and stylish living room setting. The room features a wooden daybed with a light beige cushion and two decorative pillows—one with a geometric pattern and the other with a striped design. The daybed is positioned against a wall with ornate paneling and a large, round mirror with a gold frame hanging above it. The mirror has a sunburst design, adding a touch of elegance to the room. To the left of the daybed, there is a small side table with a gold finish, holding a vintage-style alarm clock. On the right side of the daybed, a tall potted plant with lush green leaves
